text.description_html:
Laurey 74777, Aventura Venetian Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Aventura Cabinet Pull has 5 inch mounting centers and a beautiful Venetian Bronze finish. This Aventura Venetian Bronze Cabinet Pull has an easy to care for design, making it an ideal handle for high traffic kitchen cabinets. The 5 Inch Venetian Bronze Aventura Cabinet Pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection of transitional cabinet hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74777 128mm Pull Aventura Venetian Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Venetian Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
